summary: The CI environment runs Go 1.26.10 but the project's go.mod requires Go >= 1.27.0, causing golangci-lint to fail during package loading.

citations.text: level=error msg="Running error: context loading failed: failed to load packages: failed to load packages: failed to load with go/packages: err: exit status 1: stderr: go: ../go.mod requires go >= 1.27.0 (running go 1.26.10; GOTOOLCHAIN=local)\n"
